latin: Diffinitio de anima data ab Aristotele in qua dicitur: Anima est actus corporis, cum de rationali, de qua principaliter datur, intelligitur, accipienda est causaliter non formaliter.
translation: Aristotle's definition of the soul — that the soul is the actuality of the body — when it is understood of the rational soul, for which it is chiefly given, must be taken causally, not formally.
translation_note: Sense checked against farmer1998:14509; 'actus' kept as 'actuality' rather than 'act' to preserve the Aristotelian technical sense.
